response.rationale: The item is electronics with 20 days since delivery. The highest-priority applicable rule is RET-003 (priority 20), which makes electronics returns after 15 days ineligible. Final-sale (RET-012) does not apply since final_sale is false, and the defective exception (RET-020) does not apply since defective is not True. The electronics-specific rules override the standard 30-day window rules.
